essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.

sections.SUMMARY: Power-egg-middled saps all drunk always; within shown as-if. Pride-bond uprooters crested embodied lotus-shown, held. Seed-ground first mirrored waking-treasure; pomegranate show-played. Though Bhairava-shaped, rosary-held turns world within by letters. Bone-skull-ash-blood decked teaches world pure by Brahma-fullness. Self-pleased adverse bubbles; desire-burning brow-eye supreme-fire taught. Inward-aimed expanding shows unstained self in every state. Sky-cladness speaks self bare; how should Māyā's veil cover suns? All-destroyer shown from darkness-ground, gleaming-bodied. Brahma-full wearing Bhairava-form shown; differing yet freed.

rasa.dominant: pāna-vīra of drunk world-saps; vīra of held lotuses; vīra of mirrored seed; vīra of letter-turned world; raudra-vīra of gore-taught pure; raudra of brow-eye burning; vīra of aimed inward; adbhuta of bare-speaking sky; adbhuta of dark-shown destroyer; vīra-śānta of parted-freed
rasa.sthayibhava: pānotsāha at always-drunk; utsāha at uprooted-held; utsāha at first-station mirrored; utsāha at rosary-held turning; raudrotsāha at decked-teaching; raudra at bubble-jarred burning; utsāha at stain-gone shown; vismaya at veil-questioned; vismaya at gleaming-from-dark; śamotsāha at differing-yet-free
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: middled, drunk, within. Drinking relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: uprooted, lotus-shown, held. Holding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: seeded, mirrored, played. Mirroring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shaped, held, turned. Turning relished. The sthāyibhāva is fierce exultation: decked gore, taught pure. Teaching relished. The sthāyibhāva is fierceness: jarred bubbles, burning brow. Burning relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: aimed, expanding, unstained. Aiming relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: bare spoken, veil questioned. Questioning relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: dark ground, gleaming shown. Showing relished. The sthāyibhāva is peaceful exultation: worn, shown, freed. Freeing relished.
